root_request: After both families close, distinguish full-view repairs outside stronger factorizedI4 coverage from available I4/baseline repairs and harms.
executor: Root owns both completed-family bindings and any server-only mask join.
no_pairwise_recomputation: Reuse published COMPARISON pairwise counts. New work, if admitted, is only simultaneous exact intersections among the already saved selected outputs. This specification contains no duplicated numerical pairwise table.

frozen_inputs.B: Already frozen selected shared-own4 baseline; retain its exact strict common-false-rival cohort Q.
frozen_inputs.F: Completed stronger factorizedI4 reference and all four selected members.
frozen_inputs.G: Root-bound, fixed full-view method arm from the entire completed private-hop18 family. Do not choose the arm by this diagnostic; preserve all declared controls.
frozen_inputs.Q: Exact baseline B strict common-false-rival mask already bound in the complete comparison.
frozen_inputs.A_F_or_A_G: At least one individually correct member in the corresponding complete bank.
frozen_inputs.S_B_or_S_F_or_S_G: Correctness of the actual fixed deployed reducer, never an oracle member choice.

new_simultaneous_counts.unique_correct_alternative_supply: Q & ~A_F & A_G; retained/lost subdivisions by S_G.
new_simultaneous_counts.unique_deployed_full_view_repairs: Q & ~A_F & S_G; split by A_G. Include S_G repairs with no individually correct G member separately rather than forcing them into member availability.
new_simultaneous_counts.I4_repairs_retained_or_lost: (~S_B & S_F) & S_G versus (~S_B & S_F) & ~S_G; report inside Q and outside Q separately.
new_simultaneous_counts.baseline_repairs_retained_or_lost: (S_B & ~S_F) & S_G versus (S_B & ~S_F) & ~S_G; these are baseline successes relative to I4, not inferred overlap counts.
new_simultaneous_counts.shared_correct_retention: S_B & S_F split by S_G; report losses explicitly.
new_simultaneous_counts.outside_harms_and_repairs: Outside Q, report S_B & ~S_G and ~S_B & S_G; also S_F & ~S_G and ~S_F & S_G. The simultaneous S_B/S_F/S_G table avoids double counting when summarizing net changes.
new_simultaneous_counts.class_counts: Every preceding cell by truth class and optimization seed, with exact cell totals. Same-row cross-seed persistence only if identical node IDs are admitted.

small_output: Per-seed/class contingency counts over Q, A_F, A_G, S_B, S_F, S_G, and correct-member bitmasks; compact server-only cohort digest. No raw local logits, new forwards or new reader code in this source packet.
no_VALID_based_choice: TRAIN and VALID remain separate descriptive outputs. No weights, coefficients, thresholds, candidate/arm choice, epoch changes, calibration, objective changes or follow-up selection are fitted or chosen from these intersections. Retain declared reducers and selectors.
source_and_availability_limits: Read nothing before all private-hop owners close and root binds both complete families.
Bind node IDs, labels/split digest, member/epoch identities and actual reducer.
Private hop modulation/changed learned trajectories must be described exactly; do not infer changed adjacency, calibrated structural uncertainty or a new graph-view principle from the arm name.
A positive unique repair count identifies useful saved outputs, not the cause of their acquisition or a novel mechanism.
If rows or required fields cannot be admitted, mark those intersections unavailable and preserve existing counts.
